name: Enterprise View Scope
constraints: Each scope is an immutable versioned policy/expression release with digest and provenance.
The release declares inclusion rules, non-selection reasons, precedence and conflict strategy, derogations, comparability, disclosure and retention.
A scope release grants no access and never copies or masters domain facts.
Every derived output pins the exact scope release, source releases, crosswalks, world time and knowledge time.
Corrections create successor releases and issued outputs remain reproducible.
Tailoring cannot weaken constituent disclosure restrictions or convert scenarios into facts.
holds: WM-KNW-012 record-classification, retention, tailoring and defect functions require completion.
Independent Grok review and canonical parent validation remain pending.
